title: EFV-5 Jupiter
extract:
EFV-5 Jupiter is a  Scaldra assault rifle used by Scaldra Jaegers. Inflicts  Corrosive damage with a highly accurate fully automatic primary fire while its Alternate Fire charges its underslung shotgun to fire.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Alternate Fire charges for 1 second to release close-ranged buckshot.
Innate multishot of 11 pellets.
Consumes 15 ammo per shot.
Projectiles have a guaranteed  Corrosive proc.
Innate two  polarities.

Acquisition
EFV-5 Jupiter's blueprints can be purchased from Minerva of  The Hex for  Standing; component blueprints for  5,000 and the main blueprint for  15,000 to a total of  30,000, all requiring Rank 5 - Pizza Party.
This weapon is also part of the Scaldra Dominance Pack for  655.

Notes

Tips
 Primary Crux can be used to lower the Alternate Fire's ammo consumption per shot from 15 down to 6.

Trivia
The EFV-5 seems to be a modified version or variation of the  AX-52, sporting a similar upper receiver and barrel. While having a unique thumbhole stock, alternate magazine, added Efervon tubing, a larger custom handguard, and an under-barrel shotgun mounted to the handguard. Which is most likely modelled after a GP-25 grenade launcher.
The planetary naming schemes of both the EFV-5 Jupiter and  EFV-8 Mars appear to be based on the IZh Jupiter-5, a model of motorcycle popular in Eastern Europe from the 1980s to the 2000s, and is viewed as a symbol of the late post-Soviet 90s. Until its discontinuation in 2008, the IZh motorcycle brand in general was manufactured by the Izhevsk Machine-Building Plant, currently the largest firearm manufacturer in Russia.
Jupiter is also the 5th planet in the Solar System and named after the Roman god of the sky and thunder.
